A reference keeps the style of the span around it:

*bold before <<target>> bold after*

#highlight before <<target>> highlight after#

`mono before <<target>> mono after`

A label renders its own formatting: <<labelled>>.

A reference inside reference text falls back to its id: <<recursive>>.
